title: Reveal Navigation Primary Color
description: Style Reveal.js presentation navigation controls with primary theme color instead of foreground.
summary: Reveal.js navigation controls (arrows) now use the theme primary color: updated `--r-controls-color` and `.reveal .controls` rules in presentation renderer globals.css to `var(--color-primary)` instead of `var(--foreground)`, matching progress bar and links. All @semio-tech/framework-presentation-renderer-react tests pass (11).
